acceptance: Unchanged KDA analytic formula for every output and state element at 1,2,3,4,2048 rows; complete host, identity, seed, cleanup and frozen-inventory checks must all pass. Any compile or retuning attempt fails.
cache_inputs: Retain byte-identical autotune files including exact positive-infinity failed-trial sentinels. A finite sidecar binds ordered trials, finite winners and failures. Reject NaN, mixed or negative infinity, duplicate configs, malformed schemas, nonpositive finite timings and nonfinite winners. Evidence outputs remain strict finite JSON.
activation: Explicit startup-only sealed bundle arguments; absent by default. Enable disk autotune cache before constructing autotuners; reject _bench and sealed cache misses.
